open_points.subject: M03 Room pre-export name correction
open_points.text: The import renames no room: it stores a picked project's rooms under the names the v1 instance gave them (A16), and a room is never renamed or removed afterwards (R0-10). So the owner, before making the export on the VPS (R0-72), corrects there every room name of the projects to be picked that breaks this rule (owner, 2026-11-23, State 0 round-59 T1).
open_points.question: Does the pre-export correction rename the existing Room while preserving its room_id, replace it with a newly minted Room, or alter only the migration export; and which product action or migration tool performs that change despite the rule that a room is never renamed or removed?
options: Permit a one-time pre-export rename of the source Room, preserving its room_id and links
Replace each noncompliant Room with a new Room and new room_id before export
Leave the source Room unchanged and rewrite only its name in the export
Provide no correction action, making a selected project with a noncompliant room impossible to migrate
open_points.default_guess: Treat migration preparation as an explicit one-time exception: the owner uses the migration tool to change the source room name while preserving its room_id, after which the Room is immutable.

witness.initial: The selected VPS project contains room_id R with a name that violates R0-96.
events: The owner prepares the selected project for export.
The export and import preserve room_id R.
The agent later reads the imported room through the project projection.
outcomes: Under R0-96, the owner changes R's name before export, and the agent sees the corrected name under the same room_id.
Under R0-10 and M03's never-changed lifecycle, changing R's name is forbidden; the old name is imported because the import refuses no name, or the migration cannot proceed.
witness.observer: The owner during migration and the agent reading the imported room

open_points.subject: M03 Room creation and name provenance on import
open_points.text: Registry's own record, written by the owner or by Kernel for the agent.
open_points.question: For a Room stored by the import, who creates the production Room record and who counts as the writer of its name: the owner confirming the import, the import or migration closure, the source Registry, or the actor who last changed the source name?
options: The import creates the production Room, while the source record's last writer remains the name writer
The owner creates and writes the Room by confirming the import
The migration closure creates and writes the Room
The source Registry is treated as both creator and writer after its record is copied
open_points.default_guess: The import creates the production Room record and preserves its room_id and source name; the owner is the acting principal for the confirmed import, while the source record's last writer remains the semantic writer of the name.
